because.label: How to read it
because.value: Rotation order comes from the save's own projected starters. Bullpen availability is worked out from the pitches each arm actually threw, game by game, so it reflects who can really pitch tonight rather than who has the best season line. "Today" is the last game played.

because.label: Down
because.value: He pitched the last two days, threw 50 or more pitches over three days, or 30 or more in the last game; or he is on the injured list.

because.label: Limited
because.value: He pitched in the last game, threw 30 or more the game before, or 40 or more over three days.

because.label: Rested
because.value: Anything lighter; the days since he last pitched are counted from the last game played.

because.label: Day-to-day
because.value: OOTP lets a manager use a day-to-day arm, so his workload is read like anyone's.
